text:
Lina (Finance): Heads up — MeterNest renewal is up next month. We need to decide commit vs pay-as-you-go and clarify how overage credits work.

RJ (FinanceOps): Got the renewal notice. Invoice #MN-2026-03 attached in workspace. Can we get last 6mo usage breakdown before we talk terms?

Marco (Procurement): If usage is stable we should push for a 12mo commit with a buffer and monthly true-ups. Requesting a 10% introductory credit isn't crazy.

Ava (Eng): Quick technical Q: how does MeterNest measure units? Is it tokens (like our gen workloads) or per-request? We need mapping to model types.

Sam (MeterNest): Hi all — happy to help. Short answer: we have 3 SKUs: gen_tokens (per 1k tokens), embed_vectors (per 1k vectors), and batch_io (per request bundle). Mapping example:
```
gen_tokens: 1 unit = 1000 gen tokens
embed_vectors: 1 unit = 1000 embeddings
batch_io: 1 unit = up to 50 small requests
```
Overage credits: for commits > $50k/mo we offer 20% roll-forward credit for unused commit (6mo expiry) or conversion to free premium support.

Lina (Finance): Roll-forward credit with a 6mo expiry is acceptable. Can we negotiate the expiry to 9mo and include a cumulative cap on roll-forward credits?

Marco (Procurement): Also request flat-rate per unit for a 12mo commit (no surprise price increases) and a clause for a single annual true-up. Can MeterNest do volume tiers with stepped discounts?

Sam (MeterNest): We can do stepped discounts and bump roll-forward expiry to 9mo for commitments >= $75k/mo. Cap: credits can't exceed 25% of monthly committed value. We can add a clause for 1 annual true-up.

Kiran (Legal): Need to remove auto-renew or add 60-day notice to terminate. Also propose adding a data deletion SLA and liability cap aligned with our procurement policy.

Sam (MeterNest): We can add 60-day non-renewal notice and a standard data deletion clause. Liability limits will depend on enterprise package; I can send a sample redline.

RJ (FinanceOps): FYI — projected usage for Q3 based on current signals:
- gen_tokens: 8M tokens/mo
- embed_vectors: 150k vectors/mo
- batch_io: ~20k requests/mo
That's about $42k/mo at current rates, +/- 15%.

Ava (Eng): Implementation/time-to-value question: if we sign, what's the integration timeline for metrics export + billing hooks? We need prometheus + S3 usage dumps.

Sam (MeterNest): Typical integration is 2-3 weeks. We support prometheus metrics and can push daily usage CSVs to S3. We'll provide onboarding engineers to help with billing hooks.

Lina (Finance): Sounds like a plan. Next steps: Sam, please send an updated rate card, sample contract/redline, and a clarifying note on roll-forward cap. Marco/Kiran/RJ/Ava — I'll schedule a 30m vendor call early next week to finalize.

Marco (Procurement): :thumbsup: I'll prepare negotiation points and target numbers.

Sam (MeterNest): Thanks — sending docs within EOD. Looking forward to the call :wave:
